Planet modified fork of KissMP commit 5928c599ec3e0f51f0fbb5e91ffa40f178b85e4c. Original Apache 2.0 licence and source notices retained. See parent project compat/lan-source.json for original SHA-256 hashes. Planet shared contract is new. Legacy executable entrypoints retain stock protocol identity; managed Planet entrypoints must use planet-lan/1 and exclusively the closed Planet Control contract.

Managed Planet entrypoints now branch on --planet-config before all legacy startup. They use pinned Planet QUIC, bounded persistent control writers, owner lifecycle admission, a built-in stock ZIP catalogue and a loopback capability bridge. Modified legacy Lua modules provide separate managed entrypoints and guard automatic mod/level and replication effects. Legacy code is retained for comparison/compatibility but is not invoked by the managed branch. New transport modules preserve the original Apache-2.0 licensing context.
